title: Breakout
description: Classic brick breaker game. Bounce the ball off the paddle and destroy all the bricks!

title: Pong
description: Classic arcade game with three difficulty levels. Battle the AI in fast-paced paddle action!

title: Asteroids
description: Classic space shooter. Rotate, thrust, and shoot to destroy asteroids while avoiding collisions!

title: Avoider
description: Fast-paced dodging game. Control your player and avoid falling obstacles for as long as you can!

title: Aim Trainer

description: Classic checkers game. Jump your opponent's pieces and crown your kings to victory!

description: Classic two-player strategy game. Drop pieces and connect four in a row to win!

description: Classic minesweeper game. Flag the mines and reveal all safe cells to win!

description: Classic space invaders arcade game. Destroy alien waves before they reach Earth!

description: Classic tic-tac-toe game. Get three in a row before your opponent does!

description: Classic memory card game. Flip cards to find matching pairs and test your memory!

description: Classic hand game. Choose rock, paper, or scissors and beat the computer!

description: Classic code-breaking puzzle. Guess the hidden color sequence using logic and deduction!

description: Fast-paced endless runner. Jump over obstacles and survive as long as possible!
